issues.detail: The Greek 'μειζονα πλουτον' (greater treasure) is an object of the verb 'ηγησαμενος' (having esteemed/regarded). The Vietnamese translates this as 'Người coi sự sỉ nhục của Đấng Christ là giàu có hơn...', which incorrectly attributes the 'greater treasure' status to the 'insult/reproach' (ονειδισμον) rather than the correct Greek structure where the person regarded the 'treasure' of the reproach as greater than the Egyptian treasures.

The Vietnamese misses the specific nuance that the 'reproach' (ονειδισμον) IS the treasure being compared. The Greek says he regarded the 'reproach of Christ' [as a] 'greater treasure' than the Egyptian treasures.
